cities.name: Banská Bystrica
cities.local_food_tip: Try potato dumplings, soups, cabbage dishes, and mild mountain-style meals with veggie options.
cities.full_day: Morning: SNP Square walk → Clock Tower area → Coffee in the old town. Afternoon: Explore Thurzo House → Visit the Museum of the Slovak National Uprising (presented clearly and non-graphic) → Lunch with local mountain dishes → Easy walk toward Urpín Hill. Sunset: Overlook from Urpín viewpoints. Night: Relaxed old-town walk and dessert cafés.

ideas: Shaded walks by the Hron River

locations: Holiday markets on the main square

public_transport_tips: Local buses connect hills and outskirts.
Taxi is easy for quick transfers.

city_events.name: Bystrica Cultural Summer
city_events.description: Open-air performances, art corners and relaxed youth-friendly events.

cities.name: Banská Štiavnica
cities.local_food_tip: Try soups, stews, dumplings and miner-town pastries with mild flavors.
cities.full_day: Morning: Old-town walk → Holy Trinity Square → Coffee with medieval views. Afternoon: Visit Old Castle → New Castle → Lunch with Slovak miner-style dishes → Short trip to Štiavnické Lakes for an easy nature walk. Sunset: Lakeside golden-hour reflections. Night: Old-town dessert cafés.

ideas: Outdoor cafés on the main square

public_transport_tips: Buses run between lakes and the center.
Taxi is useful for castle access.
Trails start near the old town.

city_events.name: Štiavnica Cultural Days
city_events.description: Art shows, historical performances and creative workshops.

cities.name: Bratislava
cities.local_food_tip: Try bryndza dumplings, soups, baked dishes and veggie-friendly Slovak plates.
cities.full_day: Morning: Bratislava Castle → Castle Gardens → Coffee in Old Town. Afternoon: Old Town walk → Cumil statue → Michael’s Gate → Lunch with Slovak classics → Riverside stroll. Sunset: UFO Bridge or Danube promenade. Night: Dessert cafés and calm old-town squares.

ideas: Shade in Sad Janka Kráľa park

public_transport_tips: Buses run to the castle hill base.

city_events.name: Bratislava Summer Festival
city_events.description: Performances, street art and open-air shows.

cities.name: Košice
cities.local_food_tip: Try Eastern Slovak soups, dumplings, pastries and mild vegetable dishes.
cities.full_day: Morning: Hlavná Street walk → St. Elisabeth Cathedral → Singing Fountain → Coffee near the center. Afternoon: Visit Jakab Palace surroundings → Lunch with Eastern Slovak meals → Park walks and cultural corners → Gallery stop. Sunset: Calm stroll through the historic streets. Night: Dessert cafés and peaceful evening vibe.
public_transport_tips: Taxi is good for evening returns.

city_events.name: Košice Cultural Days
city_events.description: Music, art corners and youth-friendly performances.

cities.name: Poprad
cities.local_food_tip: Try mountain soups, potato dishes, dumplings and veggie-friendly warm meals.
cities.full_day: Morning: Old-town square walk → Church of St. Egidius → Coffee with mountain backdrop. Afternoon: Visit Tatranská Gallery → Lunch with local mountain dishes → Walk toward the Tatras-facing promenade. Sunset: Golden-hour views of High Tatra peaks. Night: Dessert cafés and relaxed town-center vibe.

ideas: Ice cream in the main square

public_transport_tips: Train links Poprad with all Tatra resorts.
Taxi to Štrbské Pleso is common.

city_events.name: Poprad Winter Lights
city_events.description: Festive decorations, music corners and warm winter treats.

cities.name: Štrbské Pleso
cities.local_food_tip: Try light mountain meals, soups, dumplings, veggie dishes and warm pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Lakeside walk around Štrbské Pleso → Coffee with panoramic views. Afternoon: Easy nature trails → Lunch with mountain meals → Visit lookout areas around the lake. Sunset: Lakeside reflections under golden light. Night: Calm resort stroll with dessert spots.
public_transport_tips: Trails begin right by the lake.
Taxis work well for short transfers.

city_events.name: Tatras Nature Week
city_events.description: Family-friendly outdoor walks and mountain-themed activities.

cities.name: Trenčín
cities.local_food_tip: Try Slovak soups, dumplings, baked veggie meals and pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Walk through Peace Square → Coffee in old-town corners → Climb toward Trenčín Castle. Afternoon: Explore castle viewpoints → Lunch with Slovak classics → River Váh promenade walk. Sunset: Castle hill golden-hour vibes. Night: Dessert cafés and relaxed center.

ideas: Ice cream in the old town

locations: Castle hill covered lightly in snow

public_transport_tips: Castle access involves mild uphill walking.
Taxis are convenient for quick trips.

city_events.name: Trenčín Castle Summer
city_events.description: Open-air programs, shows and cultural events.

cities.name: Žilina
cities.local_food_tip: Try dumplings, soups, pastries and mild Slovak meals.
cities.full_day: Morning: Marianske Square walk → Coffee in arcaded streets. Afternoon: Visit Budatín Castle area → Lunch with local dishes → Riverside or park stroll. Sunset: Viewpoints near the river or castle grounds. Night: Dessert cafés in the old town.
public_transport_tips: Taxis are easy for short distances.

city_events.name: Žilina Cultural Festival
city_events.description: Music, dance, workshops and local traditions.
